items.verbatim_snippet: On the recommendation of the Minister of Health, the Lieutenant Governor in Council appointed Altaf Stationwala as supervisor of Renfrew Victoria Hospital under subsection 9(1) of the Public Hospitals Act.

items.citation_text: Order in Council 766/2025: Termination of appointment
items.verbatim_snippet: The appointment was subsequently terminated effective 11:59:59 p.m. on June 20, 2025.
